Turn your race into a getaway. We've scouted the best of the Pacific Northwest so you can focus on the finish line and enjoy the journey. Proud Partners Destination Racing From coastal adventures to mountain trails, discover the perfect race weekend. Camas, WA The Scenic Gateway Beautiful lakes and tree-lined hometown charm make this a runner's paradise. PREFERRED STAYS Camas Boutique Hotel "Historic charm in downtown." FUEL & BREWS Grains of Wrath "Award-winning craft beer." LOCAL EXPLORE Lacamas Lake Trails "Miles of forested paths." RACE EVENTS Santa's Holiday Hustle 5K & Dirty Santa Trail Run 10K "Festive year-end 5K and trail 10K." Explore Camas Gaston, OR Hagg Lake Views Lush woodland paths and lakeside views offering an unforgettable running experience. PREFERRED STAYS McMenamins Grand Lodge "Funky property near Gaston." FUEL & BREWS Plum Hill Farmhouse "Family owned tasting room." LOCAL EXPLORE Henry Hagg Lake "Boating and beautiful trails." RACE EVENTS Hagg Lake Triathlon & Trail Festival "Swim, bike, run and trail races at the lake." Explore Gaston Vancouver, WA The Waterfront Hub The heart of our series. A vibrant waterfront, historic charm, and endless trails. PREFERRED STAYS Hilton Vancouver "Right on the waterfront park." AC Hotel "Modern luxury with river views." FUEL & BREWS McMenamins on the Columbia "Classic NW pub fare with a view." Beaches "Fun vibe, great happy hour." LOCAL EXPLORE Waterfront Park "Iconic pier and paved trails." Fort Vancouver "History meets wide open green space." RACE EVENTS Couve Clover Run "Annual spring classic through historic Vancouver." AppleTree Marathon "Run through history & the waterfront." Spring Classic "Multisport festival on the Columbia." Explore Vancouver Washougal, WA Gateway to the Gorge Where the suburbs meet the wild. Rolling hills, river trails, and small-town feel. PREFERRED STAYS Best Western Plus "Reliable comfort near the marina." FUEL & BREWS 54-40 Beer "Local favorite for burgers & brews." Trap Door Brewing "Great pizza and patio vibes." LOCAL EXPLORE Cottonwood Beach "Historic Lewis & Clark site." Steigerwald Refuge "Peaceful trails teeming with birds." RACE EVENTS Scary Run "The ultimate Halloween race tradition." Reflection Run "Honoring our heroes on the trails." Explore Washougal Long Beach, WA Coastal Escape 28 miles of sandy beach. Clams, kites, and misty morning runs. PREFERRED STAYS Adrift Hotel "Modern, eco-friendly, oceanfront." The Breakers "Classic beach resort condos." FUEL & BREWS Pickled Fish "Top floor dining with ocean views." Dylan's Bakery "Donuts and coffee for the beach." LOCAL EXPLORE Cape Disappointment "Lighthouses and dramatic cliffs." Discovery Trail "Paved path through the dunes." RACE EVENTS Pacific Coast Running Festival "Coastal miles along the Long Beach peninsula." Battle to the Pacific "Season-ending adventure on the coast."

About WHY RACING EVENTS | PNW Race Production Team Skip to main content Home Races Training Volunteer Give Back Community Travel Sponsors About Corporate Wellness Find My Race Home Races Training Volunteer Give Back Community Travel Sponsors About Corporate Wellness Find Your Race THE STORY OF PNW RACING: WHY. A community built on fitness, family, and fun, raising millions for causes that matter. Proud Partners $3,000,000+ Donated to Charity 50,000+ Athletes Served 21 Annual Events 2014 Year Founded What's Your WHY? Some of us race to get faster and stronger. Some to get healthy and fit. Some to lose weight. Others just to get to the finish line. Some of us race because of how it makes us feel. Some to have fun and hang with our friends. Some race to give back to an important local charity. "Regardless of your WHY, we are all united on a mission to improve our own health while improving the lives of those in need." That's the philosophy behind WHY RACING EVENTS. Since 2014, we've been bringing the Pacific Northwest community together through endurance events that celebrate every athlete, from first-timers to seasoned competitors. Meet The Team The passionate people behind every finish line. Karissa & Rod Schoene Owners & Race Directors My WHY: To keep up with our kids; To teach our kids to be good humans; To enjoy all life has to offer... Read full story We approach each WHY RACING EVENT as a challenge to give our athletes an experience that they can’t wait to tell their friends and family about and they can’t wait to come back and do it again! With the amazing WHY RACING EVENTS team, it is my goal to make sure our athletes feel the WHY LOVE that we all provide. Having grown up in the Northwest, we are entrenched in this community allowing me the ability to provide an experience that our athletes have come to expect from WHY RACING EVENTS. We love to be part of a team that strives to provide the best racing experience for our athletes. It is a family affair. We can’t do this without our family around us. From our kids, to my family and friends who have volun-TOLDED, to our sponsors, vendors, volunteers and athletes, our “WHY” is because we love the people! Karissa@whyracingevents.com Brock Schoene Race Director My WHY: To promote and encourage getting outdoors and doing challenging things with family, friends, and members of the community. Read full story I grew up at WHY RACING EVENTS and love the atmosphere of our event venues. I am so excited to be part of making the athlete experience as amazing as possible. WHY provides so many opportunities to connect with our community, supporting local beneficiaries at each event, I take pride in connecting our local volunteers to our athletes. My goal is to assist our volunteers so they can be the best support crew ever and have so much fun that they want to volunteer at our events all the time. Brock@whyracingevents.com Jesse Green Operations Read full story Jesse keeps race day running smoothly behind the scenes. Full bio coming soon. Marla Stone Volunteer Coordinator My WHY: To encourage others to test their limits and to enjoy what every day has to offer. To be an example... Read full story I began trail running in my 30’s and drifted to triathlons when I “grew up.” My love for being in the outdoors in a variety of conditions and sports culminated in beginning to work for WHY RACING EVENTS. My joy is to assist in creating the best event experience for athletes of all skill levels. It is not always winning the race but completion or improving racing times from prior events. WHY RACING EVENTS strives to provide an amazing racing experience while simultaneously raising money and awareness for our beneficiaries’ causes. The WHY Family is a reality – we care about you, the athlete, and the community around you. Marla@whyracingevents.com Jim Mitts Swim Course Manager My WHY: To have fun while being involved in the running community. Read full story I have always been involved in running. It started in grade school when I participated in AAU Junior Olympics and continued through High school. I also participated in various indoor and outdoor sports throughout my adult life. I got more involved in road races and found WHY RACING EVENTS to be a great race experience and eventually started working with them in 2021. I truly love seeing race participants competing but especially in our multi sport events. jlmitts55@gmail.com Fitness We believe in the transformative power of movement. Every event is designed to help you become your best self. Family Racing is better together. We create events where families train, compete, and celebrate as one. Fun From costume contests to live bands to epic after-parties, we make every finish line a celebration. Making a Difference We are proud to partner with local non-profits across the Northwest, raising millions to support our community. Join us in racing with a purpose. See Our Impact Proud Partners WHY RACING EVENTS "What's your WHY? Find it on the course." PNW Race Volunteer Opportunities | WHY RACING EVENTS Skip to main content Home Races Training Volunteer Give Back Community Travel Sponsors About Corporate Wellness Find My Race Home Races Training Volunteer Give Back Community Travel Sponsors About Corporate Wellness Find Your Race PNW Race Volunteer Opportunities: Be Part of the Spirit. Our volunteers are the heartbeat of every WHY RACING EVENT. Join our crew, support amazing athletes, and experience the energy of race day from the inside. Why Volunteer? More than just race day support, it's a community experience that changes lives, starting with yours. Join the Community Meet passionate people and make lifelong friends while supporting the local PNW racing scene. Our volunteer crew is a family. Earn Perks Get a limited edition volunteer shirt, snacks, and "crew credit" towards future race entries. Our way of saying thank you. Make an Impact Your encouragement at a water station or course turn can be the difference for an athlete's biggest day. You'll feel it too. Volunteer Roles From the finish line to the far reaches of the course, we have a spot for you. Course Marshal Keep athletes safe and on track at key intersections. High energy and loud cheering required! Registration Be the first friendly face athletes see. Help with bib pickup and gear bags. Aid Stations The literal life-savers. Hand out water, electrolytes, and endless motivation. Finish Line Crew Place medals around necks and celebrate the incredible achievements of every finisher. Ready to Volunteer? Behind every personal record, every emotional finish, and every first-timer crossing the line, there's a volunteer who made it possible. You just need to show up. We'll be there at the finish line with a medal, a hug, and a beer (or a root beer). Browse upcoming 5Ks and start your journey today. "Every finisher at our races was once exactly where you are now, wondering if they could do this." Coach Sarah, WHY RACING EVENTS Find My First Race Proud Partners You're Not Alone That Voice In Your Head? Everyone Hears It. The worries we hear most, and the truth that might surprise you. "What if I'm the slowest one there?" Reality: Many people walk the entire thing. The only person tracking your time is you. "What if I have to walk?" Reality: Walking isn't cheating. It's smart pacing. At our events, it's encouraged. "I'm not a 'real runner'" Reality: If you run, you're a runner. No minimum speed or body type required. "What if I can't finish?" Reality: If you can walk 45 minutes, you can finish. Our courses stay open. "I don't know what to do" Reality: We send everything you need to know. No surprises. "People will judge me" Reality: Runners cheer loudest for the back of the pack. You'll feel welcomed. A Reminder Permission Granted To walk when needed To be slow To be nervous To take up space To start before ready To call yourself a runner To cry at the finish To be proud "The only person you need to beat is the voice telling you not to try." Your Training Plan 8-Week Couch to 5K Three days a week. That's all it takes. This plan uses run/walk intervals that gradually build your endurance. By Week 8, you'll be ready to run 30 minutes, enough to finish any 5K. Week 1 Walk More, Run a Little Day 1 Alternate 60s jog / 90s walk × 8 Day 2 Alternate 60s jog / 90s walk × 8 Day 3 Alternate 60s jog / 90s walk × 8 Tip: Go slower than you think you should. If you can't talk, slow down. Week 2 Building the Habit Day 1 Alternate 90s jog / 2min walk × 6 Day 2 Alternate 90s jog / 2min walk × 6 Day 3 Alternate 90s jog / 2min walk × 6 Tip: Rest days matter. Your body builds strength while recovering. Week 3 First 3-Minute Run Day 1 90s jog , 90s walk , 3min jog , 3min walk × 2 Day 2 Repeat Day 1 Day 3 Repeat Day 1 Tip: 3 minutes will feel long. That's normal. You can do this. Week 4 Extending the Runs Day 1 3min jog , 90s walk , 5min jog , 2.5min walk , 3min , 90s , 5min Day 2 Repeat Day 1 Day 3 Repeat Day 1 Tip: Halfway there! You've built real endurance. Week 5 The 20-Minute Breakthrough Day 1 5min jog , 3min walk , 5min jog , 3min walk , 5min jog Day 2 8min jog , 5min walk , 8min jog Day 3 20min jog (no walking!) Tip: Day 3 is a milestone. Go slow. You're ready for this. Week 6 Building Consistency Day 1 5min jog , 3min walk , 8min jog , 3min walk , 5min jog Day 2 10min jog , 3min walk , 10min jog Day 3 22min jog Tip: You're a runner now. Let that sink in. Week 7 Nearly There Day 1 25min jog Day 2 25min jog Day 3 25min jog Tip: Find your pace. You should be able to hold a conversation. Week 8 Race Ready! Day 1 28min jog Day 2 28min jog Day 3 30min jog . You did it! Tip: You're ready for race day. Trust your training! Walking Welcome Race Day What To Expect No surprises. We'll guide you every step of the way. 1 Week Before Email with parking, timing, and what to bring. 2 Race Morning Arrive 45 min early. Get bib. Use restroom. 3 The Start Line up in back. Start slower than you think. 4 The Finish Cross the line. Grab your medal. You did it. The Moment Is Now The Finish Line Is Waiting. So Is Who You'll Become. You've thought about it long enough. Today's the day. I'm In: Find My First Race Free transfers Finisher medal No time cutoffs WHY RACING EVENTS "What's your WHY? Find it on the course."
